machine: Apple M4 Max, 48 GiB unified memory
protocol: Fixed Metal budget, one server at a time. Fresh process per timed request. 8-input/8-output warmup, uncached input token IDs, 64 greedy output IDs, seed 42, ignore EOS. Timings exclude loading. Client TTFT ends at the first token-bearing SSE event. TPS=63/(last token minus first); full request ends at completion of the HTTP stream. Separate per-metric medians; maximum lifetime macOS physical footprint and budget ledger peak. Normal 8 GiB serial uses ordinary attention. Both arms at 10–24 GiB request BF16 DFlash2, six proposals and GQA8. On the long prompt both arms use wide prefill, with only resident binding reuse changed. On the short handover prompt the fast mode also changes prefill geometry. Raw readings under WINDOW_WIDE are logical GGUF bytes, not physical disk traffic.

input_sources.dispatch128: First 116 and last 12 IDs of the dispatch prompt in that corpus.
